chunks: Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Sa'id narrated to us, saying: Yahya ibn Zakariyya ibn Shayban narrated to us, saying: Yusuf ibn Kulayb narrated to us, saying: Al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Abi Hamza narrated to us, from Asim ibn Hammad al-Hannat, from Abu Hamza al-Thimali, who said: I heard Abu Ja'far Muhammad ibn Ali saying:

When the Qa'im of the Family of Muhammad (peace be upon them) appears, Allah will support him with the marked angels, the following angels, the descending angels, and the close angels. Gabriel will be in front of him, Michael on his right, and Israfil on his left. Terror will preced him for a month's journey before him, behind him, on his right, and on his left. The close angels will be beside him. The first to follow him will be Muhammad, and the second will be Ali. With him is a drawn sword, and Allah will open for him Rome, Daylam, Sind, India, Kabul Shah, and the Khazar.

O Abu Hamza, the Qa'im will not arise except amidst severe fear, earthquakes, sedition, and calamities that befall people, and a plague before that, and a cutting sword among the Arabs, and severe disagreement among people, and fragmentation in their religion, and a change in their condition until the wisher wishes for death morning and evening because of the magnitude of what he sees of the madness of people, and some eating others, and his emergence will be when people reach despair and hopelessness.
So, blessed is he who encounters him and is among his supporters, and woe, all woe, to him who opposes him, disobeys his command, and is among his enemies.

Then he said: He will arise with a new matter, a new sunnah, and a new judgment, being severe upon the Arabs. His affair is nothing but killing, and he does not ask anyone to repent, nor will the blamer blame him in Allah.

key_terms.آل محمد: The Family of Muhammad, referring to the Ahl al-Bayt
key_terms.سنة جديدة: New sunnah, indicating new practices or principles established by the Imam
key_terms.طوبى: Tuba, a term of blessedness or good tidings
key_terms.فتنة: Sedition or trial, referring to social and religious turmoil
key_terms.قائم: The Qa'im, the Awaited Imam who will rise to establish justice
key_terms.لا تأخذه في الله لومة لائم: He will not be blamed by the blamer, indicating infallibility and divine authority in his actions
key_terms.ملائكة مقربون: Close angels, a specific rank of angels serving near the Divine Throne

ai.seo_question: What are the signs and conditions preceding the emergence of the Qa'im according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This narration from Al-Nu'mani’s *Kitab al-Ghayba* highlights the cosmic scale of the Qa'im’s emergence, where the four major archangels flank him, symbolizing divine authority over the natural and spiritual realms. It contextualizes his rise within the 'Major Occultation' era's eschatological signs, specifically linking his appearance to a period of intense social fragmentation and 'eating one another' (fitna) that drives humanity to despair. The text underscores the absolute nature of his rule, noting he establishes a 'new order' without offering repentance periods, reflecting the Shia belief in his decisive, unhesitating justice.
